{{Quote|No, I lured the Death Star into the Rebel trap. If not for me, that thing would still be flying around the galaxy.''"<br />"''They didn’t mention ''that'' in ''Special Delivery''.|Han Solo and Jae Juun|<ref name="JK" />}}
'''''Special Delivery''''' was a history documentary made about the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] rescue of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and their escape from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first Death Star]]. [[Jae Juun]], a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], had seen this film.<ref name="JK" />
